definitions.km: ធ្ងន់, ធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ, គ្រោះថ្នាក់
definitions.th: หนัก, รุนแรง, หนักแน่น

lao_examples.lao_script: ກະເປົ໋າໃບນີ້ໜັກຫຼາຍ, ຊ່ວຍຖືໜ້ອຍໄດ້ບໍ?
lao_examples.romanization: gapao bai nii nak lai, suai thue noi dai bor?
lao_examples.translation_en: This bag is really heavy. Can you hold it for a sec?

lao_examples.lao_script: ອາການຂອງລາວໜັກຫຼາຍ ຕ້ອງໄປໂຮງໝໍດ່ວນ
lao_examples.romanization: aakaan khong lao nak lai, tong pai hong mor duan
lao_examples.translation_en: His condition is very serious. He needs to go to the hospital right away.
